title: Cortex ModelRegistration (DRAFT v0)
description: Forge's egress to Maestro's cortex_models routing table. Forge POSTs this on a gate-pass (an eval-beating adapter served on the local GPU) so Maestro can route that discipline local-first — closing the recursive flywheel. `artifact_sha256` is the idempotency key: re-registering the same (discipline_key, artifact_sha256) is a no-op. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer. Status: DRAFT; bump $id on breaking changes.

discipline_key.description: The Forge discipline/lane this adapter serves (e.g. 'code_review'). Maestro maps it to a routing domain.

location.description: Where the adapter is served — the SGLang served-model id / --lora-paths name, or an OpenAI-compatible base URL + model alias the router can call.

eval_pointer.description: Path/URL to the held-out eval result that justifies routing here (e.g. evals/results/code_review_adapter_2026-06-22.json). The receipt that proves the adapter beat the base.

artifact_sha256.description: sha256 of the served adapter artifact (adapter_model.safetensors). Idempotency key — re-registering the same (discipline_key, artifact_sha256) is a no-op.

served.description: Whether the adapter is currently served and routable. Defaults true on a gate-pass registration; set false to deregister a lane.

base_score.description: The base model's score on the same eval suite (context for the routing weight).

adapter_score.description: The served adapter's score on the held-out eval (must exceed base_score by the promotion margin).

registered_at.description: When Forge fired the registration (ISO-8601 UTC).
